strings.mdKbSmart: • Ntse keybox fetch: txheeb xyuas lub thawv tam sim no tawm tsam Google daim ntawv tshem tawm (CRL) thiab sim ntau qhov chaw kom txog thaum nws pom lub keybox siv tau, nrog rau kev thaub qab tsis siv neeg thiab rov pib dua Google cov kev pabcuam. Khiav ntawm txhua tus kais dej thiab xav tau internet (1-3 feeb).
strings.mdKbNet: • Keybox los ntawm lub network: rub tawm lub keybox los ntawm lub chaw cia khoom (GitHub) thiab khaws cia rau /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Xav tau internet thiab siv sijhawm 1-3 feeb. Siv thaum lub ntse fetch ua tsis tau los yog thaum lub keybox hloov manually.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP kev kuaj mob: kuaj xyuas cov chaw taws teeb tswj chaw taws teeb muaj, tshuaj xyuas TEE daim ntawv pov thawj version, thiab qhia KmInstallKeybox lub xeev cov cuab yeej. Hloov tsis muaj dab tsi - ib qho khoom siv yooj yim saib.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine kos (nyeem nkaus xwb): qhia Widevine qib ntsuas (L1/L3) los ntawm dumpsys, DRM (IDM) cov ntaub ntawv tseem ceeb, thiab cov khoom muaj feem cuam tshuam. Hloov tsis muaj dab tsi hlo li.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Phau ntawv RKP kho: khiav sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh phau ntawv. Txhim kho cov teeb meem kev lees paub thaum tsis siv neeg hla tsis dhau. Txhua qhov kev khiav luam tawm ib txoj kab kev ua tiav / tsis ua tiav.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Puv RKP kho: khiav sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh puv. Tuav cov rooj plaub nyuaj thiab siv sijhawm ntev dua. Ib qho kev tshwm sim meej tshwm thaum kawg.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Pib dua GMS: clears Play Store thiab Google cov kev pab cuam (GMS+GSF) cov ntaub ntawv thiab reboots lub cuab yeej txiav. Rau kev ua pov thawj tawv ncauj nkaus xwb - nws yeej tsis kov koj cov duab lossis cov ntaub ntawv.
strings.mdCertify: • Daim ntawv pov thawj ua si: tshawb xyuas RKP daim ntawv pov thawj lub xeev ntawm lub cuab yeej thiab rov pib dua cov khoom pov thawj yog tias xav tau. Tsis kov cov ntaub ntawv siv.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER kho: kho Google cov kev pab cuam lub moj khaum (SOTER) cov teeb meem ntsig txog cov cuab yeej ua pov thawj. Siv rau qee yam khoom siv uas vam khom SOTER es tsis yog Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Thov PIF: khiav sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh quab yuam. Siv cov ntiv tes xaiv (hauv zos / qib siab) thiab hloov kho cov ntaub ntawv pif.prop/pif.json. Ib qho kev tshwm sim meej tshwm nyob rau hauv lub cav.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF kos: qhia lub xeev lub cav, cov ntaub ntawv ntiv tes (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), thiab cov cav. Kuaj nkaus xwb - nws hloov tsis muaj dab tsi.
strings.mdCanary: • Canary hloov tshiab: khiav sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Tau txais qhov tseeb Canary Cav tso tawm kom ntseeg tau tias muaj kev sib raug zoo nrog cov ntawv pov thawj RKP (Lub Ob Hlis 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Kev kuaj mob hauv cav: xyuas lub xeev TrickyStoreOSS (pid, cav), cov ntaub ntawv keybox (active vs user), tus ntiv tes tiag vs spoofed ntaus ntawv, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP cov yawm sij. Diagnostic zaub xwb.
strings.hintKbSlots: Lub module tswj ob qhov keybox slots: thawj (dawb huv, tsis txhob wiped) thiab theem nrab (thaub qab). Lub tab no qhia tau hais tias qhov twg yog qhov ua haujlwm, hloov qhov kev nyiam, lossis txhawb nqa qhov thib ob rau thawj qhov kev thov kom meej - nrog cov ntaub ntawv thaub qab thiab tag nrho cov log.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Integrity diagnosis: checks the TEE key import, the library injection inside keystore2, the revocation status (CRL), the protection-list coverage and the RKP state. Read-only — it changes nothing.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Safe re-apply:

• The protection list is rebuilt from every installed app.
• The custom-ROM compatibility layer is re-applied.
• The active keybox is re-applied.
• Google Play services are restarted.

Nothing is deleted and the primary keybox is never touched.

Continue?

strings.confirmKbSmart:

• Checks the current keybox against the Google revocation list (CRL).
• Tries multiple sources until a clean keybox is found.
• Automatic backup + restarts Google services.
